summary: Iteration 17 testing complete. All 10 features verified: 1) Plans tab shows 'Extend Subscription' title when user has active subscription, 2) Expiry warning banner appears when 3 or fewer days remaining, 3) Blue extend banner shows plan name and days remaining, 4) Payment button changes to 'Extend - Pay ₹X', 5) Extension note shows '+X days will be added', 6) Admin Live tab shows all sessions with proper status badges (SCHEDULED, ANNOUNCED, LIVE, ENDED), 7) Scheduled sessions show Announce + Go Live + Delete buttons, 8) POST /api/miniapp/admin/live-session/{id}/end endpoint works, 9) DELETE /api/miniapp/admin/live-session/{id} endpoint works, 10) Live sessions show description, metadata (stream link, superchat, tickets). Backend: 14/14 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All UI elements verified.
critical_code_review_comments: Plans tab correctly shows 'Extend Subscription' title when subscription.is_active is true
Expiry warning (yellow) appears when days_remaining <= 3, extend banner (blue) appears when days_remaining > 3
Payment button text dynamically changes to 'Extend - Pay ₹X' when subscription is active
Extension note shows '+{plan.duration_days} days will be added to your current subscription'
Admin Live tab shows proper status badges: SCHEDULED (blue), ANNOUNCED (orange), LIVE (red), ENDED (purple)
Scheduled sessions correctly show Announce + Go Live + Delete buttons
Live sessions show LIVE NOW badge with animated red dot, End Stream button
Ended sessions show only Delete button
POST /api/miniapp/admin/live-session/{id}/end correctly updates status to 'ended' and sets ended_at timestamp
DELETE /api/miniapp/admin/live-session/{id} correctly removes session from database
Live sessions display description text and metadata tags (stream link, superchat amount, tickets sold)
